quick_skim.title: EEG-VID: Task-Guided Latent Predictive Pretraining for EEG Decoding and Assistive Target Selection
quick_skim.abstract: We propose EEG-VID, a task-guided latent predictive pretraining framework for EEG decoding under session and subject shifts. EEG-VID predicts future latent EEG states from recent history using an exponential-moving-average target encoder and weak task guidance, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Across VIG-48 and BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b, Stage 1 improves mean accuracy in 41 of 42 matched backbone-dataset-protocol comparisons, including all 12 leave-one-subject-out settings, with a maximum gain of 16.22 percentage points. On the 48-region cross-day VIG-48 task, EEG-VID achieves 6.52% Top-1 and 30.50% Top-5 accuracy. In a separate six-participant offline robot-scene study, candidate-constrained target selection reaches 40.24% versus a 25% chance level after subject-specific calibration. These results support task-guided latent prediction as a transferable pretraining strategy for EEG decoding and scene-constrained assistive target selection.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: task-guided latent predictive pretraining for EEG decoding and assistive target selection; robust to session and subject shifts, transferable to real-time intent recognition

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: EEG-VID pretrains a latent predictor on recent EEG history with EMA target encoder and weak task guidance, improving decoding accuracy in 41/42 comparisons and handling session and subject shifts for assistive target selection.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 脑电信号解码常因时段、被试变化而性能下降，影响基于脑机接口的辅助目标选择等意图识别应用。作者提出EEG-VID，用EMA目标编码器和弱任务监督预测未来潜状态，再做监督微调，将迁移问题纳入预训练。在VIG-48与BCI IV-2a/2b上，覆盖41/42个匹配的主干数据集协议比较均提升平均准确率，最大增益16.22个百分点；六人离体机器人场景的候选受限目标选择也验证了其辅助判别能力。该方法可作为实时意图识别算法的稳健预训练范式，并迁移到眼动等其他生理信号。
